research_rationale: EO 10656 (1956-02-06; Establishing the President's Board of Consultants on Foreign Intelligence Activities) was read in full from the held Federal Register text (21 FR 859). Its own terms contain no end date or end condition; section 6 only sets an effective date of January 13, 1956. It ended on 1961-05-04 by express revocation in EO 10938 Sec. 4 (26 FR 3951), which in the same order established the President's Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board as a new body; the later order does not transfer the old Board's members or commands, so it is not treated as a savings transfer. The machine inventory omitted section 1 and section 6 and is replaced by seven scopes.
savings_reason: EO 10938 Sec. 4 revokes the order without a saving clause, and EO 10938 establishes the President's Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board as a new body under its own terms; no provision of EO 10938 continues the earlier Board's members, commands or appropriation authority.
earlier_end_check: Chain and held-text number citations show only EO 10938 (revocation); the EO 10939 text file repeats its sentence because the two orders share a Federal Register page.
scope_check: All sections fall within the single revocation.
independent_command_check: No section survives on its own; the funding provision depends on the Board's activities.
